en: Black‑and‑white view of a seaside bathing area in a rocky archipelago. In the foreground a sandy beach with people sitting and walking; in the water several bathers are swimming and wading. To the right, a large rock outcrop has a tall wooden waterslide structure built on it, with the slide ending in the sea. A pier or floating platform with a small boat is anchored just offshore. In the background are low rocky islands. A flagpole on the rocks flies a Nordic cross flag that appears to be Swedish. Printed caption text is at the bottom left, and a triangular logo with a serial number appears at the bottom right.
